narrative.overview: This system should feel like a personal research instrument that has been used, tuned, and trusted over time. The identity is archival and crafted: pale rice-paper fields, deep ink structure, small cinnabar or blue accents, and dense reader controls that stay quiet until needed. The workspace is product UI, not a marketing page. Beauty matters because the pages are used repeatedly, but the reader surfaces must keep navigation, search, module status, and context recovery clear.
keyCharacteristics: Rice-paper surfaces anchored by deep ink text and thin structural lines.
Serif or Songti display moments paired with practical sans body text.
Restrained accent vocabulary: dai blue, flower blue, cinnabar, seal red, and gold.
Compact, stateful reader chrome with recognizable controls and stable density.
Project-specific beauty without losing the six-space knowledge map.

rules.name: The Ink-First Rule
rules.body: Structure is carried by ink, thin lines, spacing, and type before accent color. If every section needs a colored marker to make sense, the hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The Rare Cinnabar Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar and seal red are for priority, selection, warnings, or identity marks. They should not decorate inactive UI.

rules.name: The Serif Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Use Songti or serif for page and module meaning, not for every label. Buttons, search, metadata, and dense controls stay sans.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layer Rule
rules.body: Use background tone and border contrast before adding a shadow. A panel at rest should not need a large blur to separate from the page.

dos: Do preserve the rice-paper, deep-ink, restrained accent identity when working inside `projects/foundations` and `projects/language`.
Do make module status, current section, next action, and context panel state obvious after the user returns to a page days later.
Do keep long-reading text comfortable: body around 15px, line-height around 1.78, and prose broken into meaningful sections.
Do use compact, familiar product controls for repeated workflows.
donts: Don't redesign the root homepage or `papers/brain-memory-for-ai-agents` by default; PRODUCT.md marks them as already close to target.
Don't ship generic AI-generated UI: template SaaS panels, repetitive card grids, decorative gradients, stock dashboard tropes, or excessive glass effects.
Don't flatten the workspace into a plain documentation site.
Don't spread ornamental Cyber Ink effects into dense reader surfaces when they reduce clarity.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, or decorative grid backgrounds as filler.
